selection_rule: Lowest median and every rival/winner paired ratio>1.03 in all8blocks; otherwise unresolved. Descriptive only.
controls: Eight independent processes per candidate/case, mirrored cyclic ordering; identical flat A/A8pairs per case. Fixed stopping.

review_repairs: After the committed campaign at source_commit, review repairs changed benches/portfolio.rs (filter Cargo's --bench argument; build probe reads the last row instead of rows[0], so the build checksum becomes 102028 instead of 0) and run.py (refuse a populated raw/, retain timeouts, compile and run tests/contract.rs with its hash in the manifest, write all artifacts under raw/, record both test binaries in tests.txt). Timed operations and the pre-timing validation are unchanged. The hashes above identify the frozen campaign source; the committed summaries were not replayed, and a replay from the current source records new file hashes and the new build checksum.
